geral.my_name_description: Your first name. Used by the AI to identify your tasks in meetings and separate "my tasks" from other participants'.
geral.ai_provider_description: Choose the AI provider for categorization and summaries.
geral.aws_region_description: AWS Bedrock region for AI calls.
geral.api_key_bedrock_description: Generate at: AWS Console → Bedrock → API Keys. Used as Bearer Token.
geral.model_description: AI model for categorization and summaries.
geral.model_openai_description: OpenAI model for categorization and summaries.
geral.model_gemini_description: Gemini model for categorization and summaries.
geral.model_grok_description: Grok model for categorization and summaries.
geral.local_endpoint_description: Base URL of the local server. LM Studio uses http://localhost:1234 by default.
geral.local_model_description: Name of the model loaded on the server. In LM Studio, leave empty to use the active model.
geral.local_api_key_description: Only if the local server requires authentication. Most don't need it.
geral.local_tip: For best results, use models with at least 7B parameters that support instructions in Portuguese. Recommended: Qwen 2.5, Llama 3, Mistral.

aparencia.language_description: Changes the language of the entire application interface.
aparencia.font_family_description: Font used in the content area (entries, tasks, capture). The app interface is not affected.
aparencia.font_size_description: Size in pixels for the content area ({{size}}px).
aparencia.font_preview_text_1: Meeting with product team about Q3 roadmap.
aparencia.font_preview_text_2: Decision: prioritize calendar integration before the reports module.
aparencia.date_format_description: How dates are displayed in the interface and exports.
aparencia.density_description: Controls spacing between elements. Compact shows more information per screen.

dados.backup_frequency_description: How often automatic backups are created.
dados.backup_limit_description: Maximum number of automatic backups kept. Oldest are removed ({{count}} currently).
dados.backup_none: No automatic backups found. One will be created on next startup.
dados.db_description: Configure where the database is stored. Use a cloud folder (OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive) to sync between machines.

avancado.tray_description: Keeps the app running in the background when the window is closed. When disabled, closing the window exits the app.
avancado.notifications_description: Shows operating system notifications for overdue tasks, meetings, and reminders.
avancado.task_check_description: How often the app checks for overdue and upcoming tasks.
avancado.digest_show_description: Shows a daily summary with pending tasks, yesterday's activity, and AI focus suggestions.
avancado.digest_sections_description: Choose which sections appear in the digest.
avancado.shortcuts_description: Available shortcuts in the app. Not configurable at this time.
avancado.logs_description: Access app logs and data folder for troubleshooting.
avancado.reset_db_description: Removes all data and starts from scratch. The current database will be automatically archived in the backups folder and can be restored later.
avancado.embeddings_description: Generates semantic vectors for your entries and tasks, enabling intelligent searches in Smart Chat that understand synonyms and context.
avancado.embeddings_unsupported: Your current AI provider does not support embedding generation.

modals.import_message: Restoring a backup will replace all current data. Do you want to continue?
modals.restore_message: Restoring this backup will replace all current data. Do you want to continue?
modals.reset_db_message:
WARNING: This will delete ALL data (projects, entries, tasks, meetings) and create a new database.

The current database will be archived in the backups folder.
modals.change_db_message_exists:
What would you like to do with the current database?

• Move data = Transfers the database to the new location (will replace existing one)
• Create new = Starts an empty database (old data remains at the current location)
• Use existing = Uses the database already at the destination
modals.change_db_message:
What would you like to do with the current database?

• Move data = Transfers the database to the new location
• Create new = Starts an empty database (old data remains at the current location)
modals.restore_default_message_exists:
What would you like to do with the current database?

• Move data = Transfers back to the default location (will replace existing one)
• Create new = Starts an empty database at the default location
• Use existing = Uses the database already at the default location
modals.restore_default_message:
What would you like to do with the current database?

• Move data = Transfers back to the default location
• Create new = Starts an empty database at the default location
